target: Add a config-driven, opt-in automation daemon for the orchestrator pilot — T0/T1 actions only, with a global disable flag and visible per-action receipts
invariants: Daemon may only run T0/T1 actions; T2+ refuses
Default state is disabled; explicit operator opt-in is required to enable
Global env var disable switch (DOPEMUX_ORCHESTRATOR_AUTOMATION_DISABLE=1) must always win
Every automatic action emits a receipt that names tier, source, action, outcome, and (false) mutation flag
TX/TU/T6 always refuse, regardless of config

Daemon must not invoke any of TP-DMX-ORCH-009-LIVE / 012-LIVE write paths directly; it may only schedule read-only commands and approval-phrase-required commands that the operator pre-approved via config
Daemon is a single process; multi-host scheduling is out of scope

commit.message: feat(orchestrator): config-driven T0/T1 automation daemon with global disable

pr.title: feat(orchestrator): config-driven T0/T1 automation daemon with global disable
pr.body: Implements the long-deferred automation pilot. Daemon is opt-in via config (default disabled). Honors a hard global kill switch via DOPEMUX_ORCHESTRATOR_AUTOMATION_DISABLE=1. Only T0/T1 actions are eligible for automatic invocation. Every run emits a receipt that records tier, source, action, outcome, and (false) mutation flag. TX/TU/T6 actions always refuse.

steps.task: Define the YAML config schema at config/orchestrator/automation.yaml.example: enabled (default false), actions (each with tier_max, command, schedule, on_failure), global disable doc.
validation: Schema rejects commands that map to T6/TX/TU capabilities from the approval policy.

steps.task: Implement the DOPEMUX_ORCHESTRATOR_AUTOMATION_DISABLE env-var kill switch that short-circuits every scheduling decision before any policy check.
validation: Tests assert that setting the var to '1', 'true', or 'yes' refuses every action regardless of config.
Kill switch overrides even if config.enabled is true and approval phrase is supplied.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/orchestrator/automation/scheduler.py with a deterministic cron-like scheduler (no APScheduler — keep dependencies thin).
validation: Tests cover one-shot, periodic, and 'on-event' triggers.
Tests assert deterministic ordering of concurrent triggers in the same tick.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/orchestrator/automation/daemon.py as the long-running runtime; ensure clean shutdown on SIGTERM/SIGINT and idempotent re-entry.
validation: Daemon tests run in-process and exit cleanly on signal.
Re-entry tests confirm no duplicate scheduling of the same action across restarts.

steps.task: Implement automation receipts that mirror the existing receipt model: tier, source, action, outcome, mutation=false, scheduled_at, ran_at, exit_code.
validation: Receipt fixtures round-trip via the chosen schema.
Receipts are emitted whether the action succeeds, fails, or refuses.

steps.task: Add `orchestrator automation daemon start/stop/status` CLI subcommands.
validation: CLI tests cover disabled config (refuse start), kill switch active (refuse start), and successful start in dry-run mode.
Status subcommand reports last N receipts.

steps.task: Add a refusal-matrix test that asserts the daemon refuses every T2/T4/T5/T6/TX/TU capability under every config permutation.
validation: Matrix is generated from the approval policy capability registry — adding a new T4 capability automatically adds a refusal test case.
Matrix passes with zero false positives.
Proof status is READY_FOR_REVIEW only after the refusal matrix and secaudit pass.
